description: This file contains internal utility functions for handling session keys within the ai.openclaw.app package, including normalization, validation, resolution, and construction of session keys.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming whitespace or returning 'main' if null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks whether a session key string is 'global' or starts with 'agent:', indicating a canonical main session key.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string from a device ID and optional agent ID.
